description: A moody, sophisticated living room anchored by a full-wall acoustic slat panel in dark espresso-stained oak. A soft warm amber glow radiates from a single position on the slat wall to the upper right, its light caught and partially absorbed by the dark wood slats, creating dramatic contrast — the warm pool of light against the near-black wood background. Camera is at seated-to-standing eye-level, off-center thirds composition with the sofa occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame and the dark wall filling the background, the glowing position in the upper right quadrant.
